lessons.title: Welcome to Gamma
lessons.summary: The handbook’s introduction and purpose.

sections.heading: Our workplace
sections.body: Welcome to Gamma Pizzakraft Lanka, the Pizza Hut and Taco Bell master franchisee in Sri Lanka.
keyPoints: The company emphasizes excellence, innovation and customer satisfaction.
Teamwork, integrity and innovation are central to its culture.
Understand the company journey, values, goals and standards.
sections.memoryTip: Remember: People • Values • Service.

lessons.title: Gamma Journey & Community
lessons.summary: Learn the company milestones described in the handbook.

sections.heading: The growth story
sections.body: The first Sri Lankan Pizza Hut opened at Union Place in November 1993. The 100th outlet opened in October 2022.
keyPoints: The 100th Pizza Hut was at Getuwana, Kurunegala.
It highlights an inclusive workplace and support for local communities.
sections.memoryTip: Timeline: 1993 first outlet → 2022 hundredth outlet.

sections.heading: Culture and service
sections.body: Maintain high service, inclusion, safety and employee development standards.
sections.memoryTip: Remember the company's growth milestones.

lessons.title: Gamma Strategy House
lessons.summary: Understand purpose, vision, mission and enablers.

sections.heading: The strategic house
sections.body: The Strategy House illustration has a purpose roof, vision, mission, long-term goals and operational enablers.
keyPoints: Purpose: deliver delightful experiences to stakeholders in the QSR space.
Vision: continue to be the biggest QSR operator in Sri Lanka while expanding into multiple brands and territories.
Mission: growth through strategic investment, best-in-class products and experiences, while fostering happy people and social responsibility.
sections.memoryTip: House: Purpose → Vision → Mission → Goals → Enablers.

sections.heading: Enablers
sections.body: The diagram lists six strategic enablers.
sections.memoryTip: Six foundations support the whole house.

lessons.title: RIIT & Gamma Policies
lessons.summary: The four values and the purpose of policy.

sections.heading: Respect, Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork
sections.body: Gamma's four values are Respect, Integrity, Innovation and Teamwork.
sections.memoryTip: RIIT is the shared values mnemonic.

sections.heading: Eight key Gamma policies
sections.body: Gamma policies guide decision-making and actions consistently, transparently and accountably.
sections.memoryTip: The detailed values and policies are in the separate policy lessons.

lessons.title: Salary, Overtime & Shifts
lessons.summary: Learn the salary and overtime categories in this handbook edition.

sections.heading: Salary components
sections.body: Employees receive only basic salary in the first month; other components apply from the second month onward.
sections.memoryTip: Payment conditions depend on role and company policy.

sections.heading: Overtime types
sections.body: Four types of overtime.
keyPoints: Normal OT: work beyond standard hours.
Poya OT: overtime on a Poya holiday.
Statutory OT: work on recognized statutory holidays.
Off Day OT: work on a scheduled day off.
sections.memoryTip: Normal • Poya • Statutory • Off Day.

sections.heading: Service charge / shift incentive
sections.body: Service charge and shift incentive depend on days worked. The BIA outlet has separate day and night shift incentives.
keyPoints: Follow the current HR terms and payroll policy for actual entitlements.
sections.memoryTip: For payroll questions, check the latest People & Culture documents.

lessons.title: Productivity Incentive & Bonuses
lessons.summary: Understand the handbook’s illustrative bonus structure.

sections.heading: Sales achievement tiers
sections.body: Productivity incentives are linked to monthly outlet sales achievement.
sections.memoryTip: Verify current incentive rules with People & Culture.

sections.heading: Bonus types
sections.body: Annual or bi-annual, quarterly and bold-goal bonus categories.
keyPoints: Annual and bi-annual bonuses for eligible grades.
Quarterly bonuses for Grade 8 under stated eligibility conditions.
Bold Goal bonus based on quarterly sales achievements and management declaration.
sections.memoryTip: Eligibility, cutoff dates and attendance rules matter.

lessons.title: Working Hours & Leave
lessons.summary: Read the working-hour and leave summary.

sections.heading: Working-hour table
sections.body: Working hours and off days differ for regular crew and Pizza Hut BIA crew.
sections.memoryTip: Confirm current work arrangements with People & Culture.

sections.heading: Leave categories
sections.body: Casual, annual and medical leave.
sections.memoryTip: Check current People & Culture policies and Sri Lankan law for present entitlements.

lessons.title: Resignation, Gratuity, EPF & ETF
lessons.summary: Employment exit and statutory-payment basics.

sections.heading: Resignation and clearance
sections.body: Resignation requires one month's notice and completion of the clearance procedure.
keyPoints: Complete the clearance process before final settlement.
sections.memoryTip: Follow updated HR instructions if procedures have changed.

sections.heading: Gratuity formula
sections.body: Gratuity example: (last month's salary ÷ 2) × completed years of service.
keyPoints: Example shown: LKR 100,000 monthly salary and 10 years = LKR 500,000.
sections.memoryTip: Confirm individual eligibility and calculations with People & Culture.

sections.heading: EPF and ETF
sections.body: EPF and ETF contributions.
keyPoints: EPF: employer 12% and employee 8% of EPF/ETF-liable salary.
sections.memoryTip: EPF = employer 12% + employee 8%; ETF = employer 3%.

lessons.title: Employee Welfare & Education
lessons.summary: Understand the employee support categories.

sections.heading: Welfare support
sections.body: Birthday, wedding and childbirth assistance.
sections.memoryTip: Check eligibility and amounts with People & Culture.

sections.heading: Scholarships and study
sections.body: Education support categories include:
keyPoints: GCE O/L and A/L exam achievements
sections.memoryTip: Different schemes require supporting documents.

sections.heading: Financial assistance
sections.body: Emergency loans, gratuity-based loans and the benevolent fund.
keyPoints: Emergency loan types based on tenure.
Assistance for death, medical care and disaster recovery.
sections.memoryTip: Eligibility and documentation are scheme-dependent.

lessons.title: Medical & Accident Benefits
lessons.summary: What employee coverage categories are listed.

sections.heading: Medical scheme
sections.body: Medical coverage categories include surgical and hospitalization, critical illness, life and annuity cover.
keyPoints: Six months of service are described for certain medical coverage.
Executive-level and other categories may differ.
sections.memoryTip: Confirm current insurance coverage with People & Culture.

sections.heading: Accident cover
sections.body: Accident cover applies from joining date, with defined reporting responsibilities.
keyPoints: Use the company’s incident reporting procedure.
sections.memoryTip: Report early and keep records.

lessons.title: Health & Safety at Work
lessons.summary: A safe, healthy workplace is everyone’s responsibility.

sections.heading: Workplace safety
sections.body: Follow safety guidelines, use personal protective equipment when required, and report hazards.
keyPoints: Follow safe procedures and workplace safety drills.
Report unsafe conditions or accidents promptly.
sections.memoryTip: Spot hazard → make safe → report through the approved channel.

lessons.title: Grievance Procedure
lessons.summary: How concerns can be raised and reviewed.

sections.heading: Raising a grievance
sections.body: Raise work-related or personal concerns and seek fair resolution.
keyPoints: Talk to your supervisor or manager first.
The escalation chart includes RGM/line manager, market/general management and People & Culture.
sections.memoryTip: Start with the appropriate manager and follow the formal process.

sections.heading: Escalation timing
sections.body: The flowchart mentions follow-up periods as part of the escalation route.
keyPoints: Refer to the actual grievance procedure for deadlines and forms.
sections.memoryTip: Respect privacy and document concerns appropriately.

lessons.title: Disciplinary Procedure
lessons.summary: The main procedural stages named in the handbook.

sections.heading: Six process steps
sections.body: Six stages of the disciplinary process.
keyPoints: 2. Suspension from work where needed in serious misconduct cases
sections.memoryTip: Investigate → Explain → Hear → Decide.

sections.heading: Why the process exists
sections.body: A formal process supports fairness, respect and professional standards.
keyPoints: Follow current company procedures and applicable law.
sections.memoryTip: Fair process is important for everyone.

lessons.summary: CSR, community and inclusion initiatives.

sections.heading: CSR aims

keyPoints: Decent work, reduced inequalities and partnerships

sections.heading: Highlighted projects

lessons.title: Guest Service: Moments of Truth
lessons.summary: Service sequences also appear in the handbook.

sections.heading: Formats and sequences
sections.body: DELCO and RBD have ten moments, FCD has six, and takeaway has five; use Team of Two for guest concerns.
keyPoints: DELCO: greet → guide → order → seat → drinks → starters → main course → additions → bill → thank.
FCD: greet → order → seat → serve → satisfaction → thank.
Takeaway: greet → counter → order → deliver → thank.
sections.memoryTip: Practice one sequence at a time.

sections.heading: Safety at work
sections.body: Four accident prevention rules.
sections.memoryTip: Teamwork and safety belong together.

lessons.title: Grooming & Training Standards
lessons.summary: Professional presentation and daily service.

sections.heading: Grooming basics
sections.body: A neat, clean uniform builds guest confidence and supports CHAMPS cleanliness.
keyPoints: Observe current grooming and hygiene policy.
Keep hands and working areas clean.
sections.memoryTip: Grooming is a service standard, not just appearance.

sections.heading: Training and development
sections.body: Training and development includes Pizza Hut and Taco Bell standards.
keyPoints: Use current operational and training guides for updated requirements.
Learn the standard figures and procedures.
sections.memoryTip: Learn → practise → improve.

Hospitality: friendly, fun experiences and customer satisfaction

sections.heading: Five Golden Rules
sections.body: The Customer WOW illustration reinforces:
keyPoints: Never let a customer leave unhappy.
Treat customers as you want to be treated.
Solve problems before they become complaints.
sections.memoryTip: WOW = resolve concerns before the guest leaves.

lessons.title: BLAST: Guest Complaint Recovery
lessons.summary: Illustrated way to handle customer complaints.

sections.heading: The five letters
sections.body: BLAST is the five-step approach to guest complaint recovery.
sections.memoryTip: BLAST is for listening and resolving, not debating.

lessons.title: Food Safety & Handwashing
lessons.summary: Six-step illustrated handwashing and five food-safety rules.

sections.heading: Five rules
sections.body: Follow the five food safety rules.
keyPoints: Keep food out of the temperature danger zone.
Stay home when sick and inform the manager.
sections.memoryTip: Hands → Surfaces → Rotation → Temperature → Health.

sections.heading: Six handwashing steps
sections.body: Six easy steps to wash your hands.
keyPoints: 1. Wet your hands till elbow with warm water.
3. Lather hands till elbows for 20 seconds.
5. Dry hands using a disposable towel.
sections.memoryTip: 20-second lather is the centerpiece of the illustrated procedure.

sections.heading: Temperature and rotation diagram
sections.body: Keep food out of the danger zone between 5°C and 65°C. Date, rotate and eliminate.
keyPoints: Date all food, follow first in first out (FIFO), and discard items out of shelf life.
sections.memoryTip: Keep food outside the danger zone and follow the current approved food-safety SOP.

lessons.title: Four Accident Prevention Rules
lessons.summary: Safe equipment and lifting practices.

sections.heading: The four rules
sections.body: The four accident prevention rules.
sections.memoryTip: C-U-R-L: Clean, Use, Respect, Lift.

sections.heading: Examples
sections.body: Everyday safe handling practices.
keyPoints: Clean spills immediately and display caution signs.
Use the correct tools; do not improvise with sharp objects.
Follow operating procedures and servicing schedules.
Lift using bent knees, straight back, and help when needed.
sections.memoryTip: Spot, prevent, and report hazards.

lessons.title: Fire Safety: Triangle & PASS
lessons.summary: The three fire elements and extinguisher sequence.

sections.heading: Three fire elements
sections.body: Three elements of the fire triangle.
sections.memoryTip: Removing one element can stop the fire.

sections.heading: PASS method
sections.body: The four PASS actions.
keyPoints: A — Aim at the base of the fire.
sections.memoryTip: PASS → Pull • Aim • Squeeze • Sweep.

sections.heading: When fire occurs
sections.body: Stay calm, alert the manager, use an extinguisher only if safe, and contact emergency responders.
keyPoints: Prioritize safe evacuation and follow your emergency action plan.
Do not fight a fire if untrained or if escape is unsafe.
sections.memoryTip: Safety of people comes first.

lessons.title: First Aid: The Three Ps

sections.heading: The 3Ps
